observations: Two photos show a black PlayStation console standing on a shop counter/box labeled 'McSteve Online Gadget Store'.
Console front faces are visible; there is visible dust/scratches/scuffing on the surfaces.
No controller is clearly shown in either photo.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or accessories are clearly shown.
No storage size label (e.g., 1TB) is readable in the photos.
No model identifier (PS4 Pro vs other PS4) is clearly readable in the photos.

claims.claim: Uk Used Sony PS4 Pro Console with one controller Pad
claims.evidence: Photos show a PlayStation console, but do not clearly show a controller, and PS4 Pro vs other PS4 model is not readable.

risks.risk: Console model may not be PS4 Pro (could be another PS4 variant); price depends heavily on exact model.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing the exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the worst case for a generic used PS4 console without confirming Pro status.

risks.risk: Controller may be missing or not included as claimed.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the included controller(s) showing buttons/ports and the exact quantity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no controller included).

risks.proof: Ask for a photo laid out showing power cable and HDMI cable (and any other stated items).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown (could have faults, overheating, disc drive issues).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing the console powering on and reaching the home screen (and, if possible, playing a game).

risks.risk: Storage size (e.g., 1TB) is unknown; affects value.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the system storage screen (Settings > Storage) or a close-up of the label indicating HDD size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest storage assumption.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the console model label/serial sticker (back/bottom) showing the exact PS4 model number.
Clear photo showing the included controller(s) (quantity = 1) and any ports/condition.
Photo laid out of all accessories included (power cable and HDMI at minimum).
Short video clip: power on → reaches PS4 home screen (and ideally loads a game).
Photo of Settings > Storage showing total capacity (e.g., 1TB) or a label close-up.
response.reason: The photos confirm a PlayStation console exists but do not clearly prove it is a PS4 Pro, nor do they show the controller or accessories, and working status/storage size are not verifiable from the images.
